answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can demand verifiable proof of useful work before granting trading rights: each agent must periodically solve a task whose result peers can cheaply check, building a public record as solid as basalt. Identities with no history sit on a low mesa of trust with capped transaction volume, and the umber shadow of suspicious clusters, many accounts sharing one funding source or timing pattern, triggers automatic review. Faking one identity is cheap; faking a hundred verified histories is not.
